## Change

Describe the user-visible behavior and why it is needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] I tested the affected behavior and listed the commands/results.
- [ ] I stated the compatible DSH version and checked `0.1.2-rc.1` behavior.
- [ ] I removed credentials, authorization URLs, real IPs/hostnames, device IDs, session text, and private logs.
- [ ] Screenshots and diagnostics are redacted.
- [ ] I documented any license or third-party attribution impact.
- [ ] I did not modify or vendor `dsh-core`.
